fixture_name: Four-lane arterial improvement — US preliminary design (FHWA case study, PD)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Queuing/turning/parking interference at closely-spaced intersections within functional area is a core preliminary-design safety issue on a corridor with recorded high-accident designation, so the concern has real substance.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim is supported by a verbatim quote from EV-US-016 matching the statement text, and the location detail is tied to the recorded case-study entry cited in the confidence basis.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern with no normative_basis_note, keeping the safety observation categorically distinct from any compliance question under FHWA RSA semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommends two concrete, viable preliminary-design actions—turning-movement restrictions and relocating parking stalls outside the intersection functional area—rather than a null or generic check.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged as potentially present on the commercial corridor, but their impacts are not analyzed, fitting the 'acknowledged but not applicable to the stated mechanism' tier.

justifications.substance: Queue storage failure and spillback between signals 650 ft apart is a well-established safety/operational hazard, and checking coordination at preliminary design is exactly when it can be fixed.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal 650-ft spacing claim is backed by a verbatim quoted sentence (EV-US-001); the spillback mechanism is transparently labelled as an inference from that recorded fact rather than invented.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern with a check-and-coordinate ask, keeping the RSA advisory role distinct from any compliance determination and fitting the preliminary-design stage.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Names concrete, viable measures (signal coordination, Do Not Block Intersection signs, enhanced signing/display conspicuity) actionable at preliminary design rather than a null or generic directive.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists crossing both signalized intersections are explicitly acknowledged, with a stated reason why the queue-spillback mechanism scopes exposure to vehicle occupants.
